user_instruction: 一般任务用 GPT-6.1 Sol high；大批量审核可用 Luna max subagent
bulk_review_scope: Pinned, bounded record batches; per-record decisions with source locators. Ambiguous source, unit, identity, relation or taxonomy decisions escalate to Sol.
subagent_write_scope: Isolated candidate/review artifacts; shared facts are merged by one reviewer-approved transaction.
runtime_note: This policy selects future dispatch arguments. It does not change a running agent's model, app settings, evidence rules, or publication permission.
